mapper.select: /** [sql-consignedMaterialsReg.xml] ConsignedMaterialsRegMapper.consignedMaterialsRegDetailList **/ SELECT MF16.MF16_COMPANY , MF16.MF16_FACTORY , MF16.MF16_HNO , MF16.MF16_NO , MF16.MF16_SEQ , MF16.MF16_CODE , MF16.MF16_QTY , MF16.MF16_GBN , TO_CHAR(MF16.MF16_INDTE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MF16_INDTE , MF16.MF16_EMPNO , MF16.MF16_UPDTE , MF16.MF16_UPD_EMPNO , CM08.CM08_NAME , CM08.CM08_OPUNT , CM08.CM08_GBN , (SELECT CM05_NAME FROM TB_CM_05 WHERE CM05_COMPANY = CM08.CM08_COMPANY AND CM05_FACTORY = CM08.CM08_FACTORY AND CM05_VALUE = CM08.CM08_OPUNT AND CM05_CODE = 'C005' ) AS CM08_OPUNT_NAME FROM TB_MF_16 MF16 INNER JOIN TB_MF_15 MF15 ON MF16.MF16_COMPANY = MF15.MF15_COMPANY AND MF16.MF16_FACTORY = MF15.MF15_FACTORY AND MF16.MF16_HNO = MF15.MF15_NO INNER JOIN TB_CM_08 CM08 ON MF16.MF16_COMPANY = CM08.CM08_COMPANY AND MF16.MF16_FACTORY = CM08.CM08_FACTORY AND MF16.MF16_CODE = CM08.CM08_CODE WHERE MF16.MF16_COMPANY = #{mf15Company} AND MF16.MF16_FACTORY = #{mf15Factory} AND MF16.MF16_HNO = #{mf15No} ORDER BY MF16.MF16_COMPANY,MF16.MF16_FACTORY,MF16.MF16_HNO,MF16.MF16_NO DESC
